# Exact arithmetic: powers of i come from a lookup table of Gaussian integers, so no floats.

IPOW = [1 + 0j, 0 + 1j, -1 + 0j, 0 - 1j]  # exact values of i^0..i^3


def ipow(k):
    return IPOW[k % 4]


def path_from_f(f, n_steps):

    pts = [0 + 0j]
    for n in range(n_steps):

    return pts
